remarks: Discover a rare opportunity in one of the South Bay’s most coveted enclaves—the Upper Hollywood Riviera. Step inside and feel the difference. The open, light-filled living spaces flow seamlessly to the outdoors, where the true lifestyle of the Riviera unfolds. This impeccably maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence with a 2-car attached garage is the ultimate turnkey coastal retreat, fully furnished with high-end designer pieces creating a polished, magazine-worthy atmosphere that requires nothing more from you than unpacking a suitcase.
